title: 브러시의 호박빛
suno_analysis_sp: Jazz trio ballad featuring a baritone male vocalist. The arrangement consists of a grand piano, upright bass, and a drum kit played with brushes. The piano performs sparse, jazz-chord voicings and melodic fills between vocal phrases. The upright bass plays a walking line in a relaxed swing feel. The drummer uses brushes on the snare drum to create a continuous, soft swishing texture. The vocals are delivered in a low-register, intimate, spoken-word style that transitions into melodic singing. The tempo is a slow 70 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of C major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[soft piano chords, upright bass walking line, brushed snare drum]

[Verse 1]
[low baritone male vocals, intimate delivery]
금요일 밤이다 [piano melodic fill]
지하 재즈 클럽이다
계단을 내려간다
문을 열면 어둡다
테이블에 촛불이 하나씩 있다
무대에 트리오가 있다
피아노 베이스 드럼 세 사람이다
스포트라이트가 하나 켜져 있다

[Verse 2]
드러머가 브러시를 들었다
스틱이 아니라 브러시다
스네어를 쓴다
솔솔 소리가 난다
